teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: house, flat, apartment, building, room, live, city, centre, street, near, big, small

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
house, flat, apartment, building, room, live, city, centre, street, near, big, small
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where do you live? (asking location)
• I live in a modern flat (stating type of home)
• My house is near the park (describing location)
• Is it big or small? (asking size)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Vowel sounds in 'house' /haʊs/ vs 'flat' /flæt/. Word stress in 'apartment'.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Vowel sounds in 'house' /haʊs/ vs 'flat' /flæt/. Word stress in 'apartment'.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Verb 'live' + Prepositions of location ('in a house', 'near the centre', 'in the city')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Verb 'live' + Prepositions of location ('in a house', 'near the centre', 'in the city')
Controlled Practice:
You live in a flat near the park. What do you say?
options: I live in a flat near the park.
answers: I live in a flat near the park.

elements.content: Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Where do you live, David?
B: I live in a flat near the city centre.
A: Is it a big flat?
B: No, it is a small flat, but it is very comfortable.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to Anna describing her new house and choose the correct location on the map.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can describe my type of home (house, flat/apartment) and state where it is located.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can describe my type of home (house, flat/apartment) and state where it is located.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
